overall_comment: Predictions are based only on structured MRI metadata without DWI/ADC, perfusion, spectroscopy, or SWI/GRE. The strongest imaging signal is an aggressive enhancing/necrotic, edematous, infiltrative right parietal-cortical mass with ependymal invasion and satellites. Molecular confirmation remains required for definitive WHO CNS5 classification.
